speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: Payless paydays are wearing on the morale of the workers simply because they have to pay their bills now. They don't have the option to seek temporary work elsewhere because they have to report here by law.

speaker: SPEAKER_01
text: Personally, I've reached out to my mortgage company to look for relief and begun that process.

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: Today, a listening conference with the mostly Democratic Michigan delegation, fresh from voting for retroactive pay once the government reopens. Organized by Congressperson Andy Levin, only one Republican, Fred Upton, who voted with Democrats to reopen the government, was invited to attend, but missed his plane.
